architecture.decisionBackend: worker by default; explicit main-thread compatibility setting
architecture.nativePreparation: 8ms cooperative batch target; a single native API call can exceed it
architecture.workers: Separate persistent decision/tactical-field and flight clients using the same module request dispatcher
architecture.cloneBoundary: Prepared plain-data knowledge and numeric capability facts; no Actors, Documents, functions, secret rolls or mutations
architecture.nativeAuthority: Native geometry and fresh worker candidates revalidate the original choice before action reservation and after presentation delays
caches: Area geometry shared across equivalent slot/Soul Cage bindings
One Region per area and one line-of-effect check per target/origin
architecture.failurePolicy: Pause on worker failure; no silent synchronous forecast fallback
architecture.cancellation: Abort interrupts the worker CPU job; scene teardown closes both clients
